description: T-0040: how function names must be stored for Excel for the web to recognise them, and FILTERXML on the web. A1/A2: PERCENTOF stored bare vs as _xlfn.PERCENTOF (A1 is listed in bare_function_names, so the case builder writes it bare; T-0416). A3/A4: an eta-reduced function argument stored bare (SUM) vs as _xleta.SUM. A5/A6: _xlfn. on a classic function and on an unknown name. A7: FILTERXML with a well-formed document and XPath (its page says it relies on Windows). Results of ERROR.TYPE: 5 = #NAME?, 3 = #VALUE!; IFERROR(..., 0) = no error. A1 and A3 are not scored: they ask how a stored (file) formula loads, while the engine reads the spec text as a typed formula, where PERCENTOF and an eta SUM are valid; their oracle values are the evidence (docs/excel-semantics/xlsx-storage.md).
